fields.description: Master switch for the Jun 9 process-automation suite: Closed-Won SMS alerts, the won-but-unconverted reminder, Payment Received alerts, the PRO-0204 hand-off step engine, contract generation, and the Sales Pipeline board. OFF = the system behaves as it did before (silent timestamps still accumulate so the boards are meaningful from day one when enabled). Server behavior changes immediately; desk buttons/pages update on each user's next page load. Always-on regardless of this switch: the Lead quick-entry dialog and Opportunity field descriptions (form-level fixtures), and the Task Dashboard block (only appears where explicitly added to a Workspace).
fields.label: Enable Process Automation Suite

fields.description: Item Group the consumables picker on Maintenance Records is limited to (e.g. "Service"). Leave empty to allow any stock item.
fields.label: Consumables Item Group

fields.description: Last-resort source warehouse for consumables on Maintenance Records, used when neither the contract feature's warehouse nor the technician's vehicle warehouse is set.
fields.label: Default Consumables Warehouse

fields.description: The Item whose Serial Nos represent customer water features. Drives the Serial No pickers on Sales Orders and Maintenance Contracts.
fields.label: Water Feature Item

fields.description: Time Kiosk: suggest clocking in when the technician is within this many meters of a maintenance site (coordinates on the Sapphire Maintenance Profile). 0 disables the suggestion.
fields.label: Site Geofence Radius (m)

fields.description: Text the technician (via the Triton gateway) when they clocked out of a maintenance project without submitting a visit form. Runs hourly; uses Employee Cell Number.
fields.label: SMS Nudge for Unsubmitted Maintenance Forms

fields.description: When a visit is submitted with out-of-range water chemistry, draft a follow-up visit due this many days later. 0 disables.
fields.label: Out-of-Range Follow-Up Visit (Days)

fields.description: On finalize, email the customer their service report (the Maintenance Record Print PDF), sent to the Customer's primary contact. Off by default.
fields.label: Email Service Report to Customer on Finalize

fields.description: At a fixed-term contract's End Date, auto-renew it for another one-year term (§9.2) instead of expiring — unless a non-renewal notice is set on the contract. Off by default.
fields.label: Auto-Renew Maintenance Contracts

fields.description: Bill Monthly/Quarterly/Annually maintenance contracts in arrears: a daily job drafts one Sales Invoice per period (base Recurring Amount + rolled-up consumables) against the linked Sales Order. Draft only — a human submits it, which triggers the Stripe auto-charge. Off by default.
fields.label: Recurring Maintenance Billing

fields.description: Each morning, text (Triton) and email every technician their scheduled maintenance visits for the day, ordered by nearest-neighbour route from the site coordinates. Off by default.
fields.label: Morning Technician Dispatch Digest

fields.description: When a Stripe auto-charge on an invoice is declined, retry the saved card on the schedule below, email the customer each attempt, and — if every retry fails — alert Accounts, turn off the customer's autopay, and apply a Service Hold (pausing maintenance visit generation). Off by default.
fields.label: Declined-Card Dunning

fields.description: Days after the first decline to retry the card, comma-separated. Default "2,4,7" = up to 4 attempts over about a week (the initial charge plus three retries). Blank/invalid falls back to the default.
fields.label: Dunning Retry Schedule (days)

fields.description: Weekly: draft a Material Transfer request per technician vehicle warehouse, restocking the consumables issued from it over the past week.
fields.label: Weekly Truck Restock Suggestions

fields.description: Warehouse the restock Material Transfers draw from (e.g. the main inventory room).
fields.label: Restock Source Warehouse

fields.description: Master switch for Google-Docs-style live form editing. Changes apply on collaborators' next page load — no deploy needed.
fields.label: Enable Live Collaborative Editing

fields.description: Doctypes with live collaborative editing. Before adding one, audit its form scripts for field-change handlers with side effects — they re-run on every collaborator's screen when remote values arrive (see the checklist in public/js/collab/live_form_sync.js).
fields.label: Collaborative Doctypes

fields.description: Employees texted (via the Triton gateway) when an Opportunity is marked Closed Won, and reminded daily about won opportunities still awaiting a Project. Numbers come from each Employee's Cell Number — no number stored here.
fields.label: SMS Recipients

fields.description: The daily reminder lists Closed Won opportunities that still have no Project after this many hours. Set 0 to disable the reminder entirely.
fields.label: Unconverted Reminder After (Hours)

fields.description: Opportunities sitting in a stage this many days turn amber on the Sales Pipeline board.
fields.label: Stale After (Days, Amber)

fields.description: Opportunities sitting in a stage this many days turn red and pulse on the Sales Pipeline board.
fields.label: Very Stale After (Days, Red)

fields.description: The Finance person responsible for Accounts Receivable hand-off steps (accounting project + invoice, payment receipt). Step notifications and overdue escalations for those steps go to this Employee.
fields.label: Accounts Receivable Rep

fields.description: Optional. Holiday List used to compute hand-off step due dates in business days; its holidays are skipped in addition to weekends. Leave blank to skip weekends only.
fields.label: Holiday List (Due Dates)

fields.description: Master switch. Weekday mornings at 06:30 (site timezone) a per-user briefing is pre-generated for every recipient below: today's + overdue tasks, today's calendar, open pipeline, due ToDos. Surfaced in the "Morning Briefing" workspace block and optionally emailed.
fields.label: Enable Morning Briefing

fields.description: Narrate the briefing with Gemini (Vertex AI key from Triton Settings). OFF = deterministic markdown from the same data, zero AI cost.
fields.label: Use Gemini Narrative

fields.description: Who gets a pre-generated briefing each weekday morning. Any staff user can still pull one on demand from the workspace block.
fields.label: Briefing Recipients

fields.description: Seconds each project stays on screen in the rotating carousel.
fields.label: Carousel Rotation (Seconds)

fields.description: How often the display re-fetches live data. It also reloads itself automatically when a deploy changes the asset build.
fields.label: Data Refresh (Seconds)

fields.description: Rotate a KPI band (Executive + Operations snapshots) on the /wall TV display. Requires KPI Dashboards enabled above.
fields.label: Show KPI Band on Wall

fields.description: Open-Meteo coordinates for the weather chip (default: HQ, Bountiful UT).
fields.label: Weather Latitude

fields.description: Master switch. ON: AI assistants connected through Frappe Assistant Core may not mutate documents directly — each write becomes an AI Pending Action the requesting user (or a System Manager) must confirm in the desk; every executed mutation lands in the append-only AI Action Log. OFF: behaviour is unchanged (FAC's own audit log still records everything).
fields.label: Require Confirmation for AI Writes

fields.description: Unconfirmed proposals expire after this many hours (hard-checked at confirm time; an hourly sweep tidies the list view).
fields.label: Pending Action TTL (Hours)

fields.description: Doctypes whose AI create/update skips confirmation (still logged, marked Auto Approved). Delete / submit / workflow / code execution never skip.
fields.label: Confirmation-Exempt Doctypes

fields.description: Record per-call Gemini token counts (AI Model Usage) for the in-app drafting/briefing features.
fields.label: Track Gemini Token Usage

fields.description: Delete AI Action Log rows and decided Pending Actions older than this many days. 0 = keep forever.
fields.label: Action Log Retention (Days)

fields.description: Master switch. Nightly at 05:00 (site timezone) one KPI Snapshot is precomputed per department (Finance, Sales, Operations in this release) and surfaced in the "KPI Dashboards" workspace cockpit. Off = no snapshots run and the cockpit shows a disabled notice. Set per-department targets in the KPI Target list to light up Good/Watch/Bad badges.
fields.label: Enable KPI Dashboards

fields.description: Delete KPI Snapshot rows older than this many days (trend history window). 0 = keep forever.
fields.label: Snapshot Retention (Days)

fields.description: Show each field's description as a small ⓘ info icon next to its label (hover, focus, or tap to reveal) instead of as inline help text under the field, across all desk forms. Applies on each user's next page load. Turn off to restore the standard inline help text.
fields.label: Field Description Info Icons

fields.description: Create Contacts and Addresses in a quick-entry dialog instead of routing to the full form. Opened from a Customer, Opportunity, Project or other party form, the dialog pre-fills the Account, links the new record to the right documents automatically, and the form's contact/address lists refresh in place. Applies on each user's next page load; turn off to restore the standard full-form create flow. Note: the Contact "Account" field stays editable and kept in sync with the Links table regardless of this switch.
fields.label: Contact & Address Quick Entry

fields.description: Master switch for the Document Merge tool. ON: System Managers get a "Merge into…" button on any non-submitted document (and a "Merge…" bulk action in list views) that consolidates a duplicate into the record you keep — repointing every link, dynamic link, child-table reference and soft reference (attachments, comments, ToDos, emails, tags) at the survivor, backfilling the survivor's blank fields from the duplicate, then deleting the duplicate. Always shows a side-by-side preview and a typed confirmation first; every merge is recorded in a Document Merge Log. OFF (default): the button is hidden and the server endpoints refuse. Because a merge deletes the absorbed document and cannot be undone, keep this OFF until you intend to use it.
fields.label: Enable Document Merge Tool

fields.description: Master switch for the Product Configurator's ERPNext generation. ON: configurations get the "Item + BOM + Selling Price" button (creates the configured Item, a submitted default BOM from the parts list, and a Standard Selling Item Price) and products get "Create Component Items" (creates the component Items and their Suppliers). OFF (default): configurations, live pricing and the printable build/QC/pricing sheets all still work — only the buttons that create Items/BOMs/Suppliers are disabled and their server endpoints refuse. Users also need the usual Item/BOM/Item Price permissions; the "Product Engineer" role covers only the configurator doctypes.
fields.label: Enable Product Configurator Generation

fields.description: Switch for the Package Dispatch form's auto-fill conveniences. ON: picking a catalog Item on a dispatch line pulls its name + selling value, and picking a Customer fills the recipient name/address/phone from their primary address. OFF (default): the form, its declared-value total, the printable Package Dispatch Sheet and the submit flow all still work — you just type the item values and address by hand. Applies on each user's next page load (desk reads the flag from bootinfo); the server auto-fill endpoints read the live value.
fields.label: Enable Package Dispatch Auto-fill

fields.description: Purchase Orders whose grand total exceeds this amount can only be *submitted* by a user holding the "PO Approver" role (the CEO) — everyone else must save the draft and hand it to the approver (WI-013). Set to 0 to disable the check. Per-project and percentage-of-budget thresholds are planned (WI-058).
fields.label: PO Approval Threshold (Amount)

fields.description: ON: whoever raised a Material Request cannot also *submit* the Purchase Order that fills it — they may draft it, but another "PO Creator" must submit (WI-066). No role overrides this, not even "PO Approver"; only Administrator, which also bypasses the threshold above. OFF = the check does not run and a requester can commit their own request unaided. Only applies to POs whose lines carry a Material Request link. Server behavior changes immediately.
fields.label: Enforce PO Separation of Duties

fields.description: Where a supplier pick-up run starts and, by default, ends - the Project Budget tab's "Pick Routing Map" button. Any address Google Maps can find. Blank falls back to the shop, 85 W 300 S, Bountiful, UT 84010. The map itself uses the browser key in Travel Settings, which needs the Directions API enabled on it as well as Maps JavaScript.
fields.label: Pickup Route Start Address

fields.description: Master switch. ON: the nightly job refreshes each vehicle's maintenance status (OK / Due Soon / Overdue) as cadence dates pass, and (with reminders on) notifies fleet managers when a vehicle newly slips. OFF = no background job runs; the Fleet Vehicle / Vehicle Maintenance Log forms still work, and due dates still compute on save. Server behavior changes immediately.
fields.label: Enable Fleet Maintenance

fields.description: Notify fleet managers (users with the Fleet Manager or Maintenance Manager role, else System Managers) in the desk notification bell when a vehicle newly becomes Due Soon or Overdue. Turn off to keep the due dashboard without notifications.
fields.label: Send Fleet Reminders

fields.description: Days between weekly services (the schedule's default is 7).
fields.label: Weekly Interval (Days)

fields.description: Months between oil changes (the schedule's default is 3).
fields.label: Oil Change Interval (Months)

fields.description: Months between dealership check-ups (the schedule's default is 6).
fields.label: Dealership Check-Up Interval (Months)

fields.description: Months between windshield wiper replacements (the schedule's default is 6).
fields.label: Wiper Replacement Interval (Months)

fields.description: A vehicle shows "Due Soon" this many days before a service comes due.
fields.label: Due Soon Window (Days)

fields.description: Show the New Jobs Queue widget (most recently created Active Projects) on the Finance Dashboard. Each widget appears only where the block is placed (the Finance Dashboard workspace) and only for finance roles.
fields.label: Enable New Jobs Queue Widget

fields.description: Show the Who's Working widget (employees currently clocked in, from open/paused Job Intervals) on the Finance Dashboard.
fields.label: Enable Who's Working Widget

fields.description: Show the Weather chip on the Finance Dashboard (uses the same keyless Open-Meteo coordinates as the Wall display, configured above).
fields.label: Enable Weather Widget

fields.description: Show the daily horoscope widget (pick-a-sign) on the Finance Dashboard.
fields.label: Enable Astrology Widget

fields.description: Show upcoming events from the Finance Google Calendar on the Finance Dashboard. Requires the calendar id below, the Calendar API enabled on the Drive service account's GCP project, and the calendar shared with that service account.
fields.label: Enable Finance Calendar Widget

fields.description: The Google Calendar id of the "Finance" calendar (e.g. the long ...@group.calendar.google.com id, or an email address). The calendar must be shared with the Drive service account's client_email. Use the calendar widget's list helper to discover it.
fields.label: Finance Google Calendar ID

fields.description: Maximum number of upcoming events the Finance Calendar widget shows.
fields.label: Finance Calendar Max Events

fields.description: Optional override for the public horoscope API base URL (no key). Leave blank to use the built-in default.
fields.label: Horoscope API Base URL

fields.description: Master switch for the Cactus & Tropicals fountain-move intake feature. ON: the Fountain Move Request list, its "Send Intake Link" action and the invite emails become available in the desk. OFF (default): the code ships dormant — the doctypes exist but nothing is surfaced and the public form 404s regardless of the switch below. Applies on each user's next page load (desk reads the flag from bootinfo).
fields.label: Enable Fountain Move Intake

fields.description: Publishes the guest-accessible form at /fountain-move. This is the app's only unauthenticated write path — read the pre-flight checklist in crm_enhancements/README.md before flipping it. Requires a Turnstile secret key below (enabling without one throws), and requires confirming that the reverse proxy OVERWRITES X-Forwarded-For rather than appending to it. OFF: /fountain-move returns 404 while the desk list, retry and spam actions keep working.
fields.label: Publish Public Intake Form

fields.description: ON (default): a clean submission converts to Customer / Address / Contact / Lead / Opportunity automatically in a background job. OFF: submissions land as Fountain Move Requests and wait for someone to press "Retry Conversion" — useful while tuning the anti-spam settings or the field mapping.
fields.label: Convert Submissions Automatically

fields.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key (public — it is emitted into the page source by design). Create the widget for this site's hostname at dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile.
fields.label: Turnstile Site Key

fields.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key, used server-side for siteverify. Never leaves the server. The public form cannot be enabled while this is blank.
fields.label: Turnstile Secret Key

fields.description: Google Maps browser key for address autocomplete on the public form. Enable BOTH "Maps JavaScript API" and "Places API (New)", and restrict the key by HTTP referrer to this site's hostname — it is emitted into a page any anonymous visitor can read. Use a SEPARATE key from Travel Settings so a leak here can be rotated without breaking trip maps. Leave blank to ship plain manual address fields instead (the form works either way).
fields.label: Fountain Move Maps API Key

fields.description: Per-photo upload cap in MB. The effective cap is the lower of this and the site's own max_file_size (default 25 MB), read at request time.
fields.label: Max Photo Size (MB)

fields.description: Days an emailed intake link stays valid. An expired link still opens the form — it just stops attributing the submission to the invite.
fields.label: Invite Link Expiry (Days)

fields.description: Fallback owner for Opportunities created from the bare public URL (a submission that arrived through an emailed invite is owned by whoever sent it). Also the fallback notification recipient. Opportunity.opportunity_owner is mandatory, so conversion fails loudly when this is blank.
fields.label: Default Opportunity Owner

fields.description: Stamped onto Customer, Lead and Opportunity so every Cactus & Tropicals referral is filterable in one click. Seeded to "Cactus & Tropicals".
fields.label: Lead Source

fields.description: Value stream for the created Opportunity (mandatory on Opportunity). Seeded to "Service" — a move is labour on an existing product, not a design or a build.
fields.label: Value Stream

fields.description: Company for the created Lead and Opportunity. Defaults to the global default company when blank.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Territory for the created Customer, Lead and Opportunity. All three Cactus & Tropicals stores are in Utah. Leave blank to insert with the field empty (Customer inserts with ignore_mandatory).
fields.label: Territory

fields.description: Customer Group when the submitter picks "Residential". Must be a leaf group — v16 rejects group nodes outright.
fields.label: Customer Group (Residential)

fields.description: Customer Group when the submitter picks "Commercial". Must be a leaf group.
fields.label: Customer Group (Commercial)

fields.description: Extra addresses copied on every new submission and on every conversion failure, alongside the Opportunity owner. Leave empty to notify the owner only.
fields.label: Fountain Move Notification Emails

fields.description: Partner store locations offered in the "Purchased at which location" dropdown. Seeded with the three Cactus & Tropicals stores. Editing these needs no deploy. If every row is deleted or disabled the form falls back to the three built-in stores rather than rendering an unsubmittable dropdown.
fields.label: Partner Store Locations

fields.description: Master switch for online contract signing: the "Send for Signature" action on Project Contract and the signed-document delivery. Off by default. The paper flow (Mark as Signed) works either way.
fields.label: Contract E-Signature

fields.description: Publish the customer signing page at /contract-sign. This is an unauthenticated page that executes a legally operative document, so it has its own switch: flip it only after the Turnstile keys, the consent and disclosure text below, and the signature block in the live Contract Template are all in place. Off 404s the page and leaves the desk actions working.
fields.label: Publish Public Signing Page

fields.description: Who collects the signature. "In-House" uses the signing page on this site. Each request records the provider in force when it was sent, so changing this never affects links already out.
fields.label: Signature Provider

fields.description: Days a signing link stays valid. An expired link shows the customer a friendly message and offers to send a fresh one; staff can also resend, which issues a new link and retires the old one.
fields.label: Signing Link Expiry (Days)

fields.description: Days of silence before each nudge, comma-separated. "3,7" means: nudge 3 days after the link is sent, then 7 days after that nudge if it is still unsigned, then stop. Each nudge issues a fresh link (the previous one stops working, and anyone opening it is told to check their latest email), so the clock restarts from the most recent send. After the last nudge the contract owner is alerted once. Leave blank to never chase.
fields.label: Signature Reminder Gaps (Days)

fields.description: After signing, offer the customer a secure link to save a card for automatic payments (Exhibit B of the maintenance agreement promises exactly this). Entirely optional for the customer — declining never affects the signature.
fields.label: Offer Autopay After Signing

fields.description: Cloudflare Turnstile site key for the signing page (public — it is emitted into the page source by design). May be the same widget as the intake form if its hostname matches.
fields.label: Turnstile Site Key

fields.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key, used server-side for siteverify. Never leaves the server. If Cloudflare cannot be reached the signature is still accepted and flagged for review — a signer already holds a single-use link sent to a known address, so blocking execution would cost a contract without closing a real gap.
fields.label: Turnstile Secret Key

fields.description: Name printed on the Service Provider signature line of an executed agreement. Recorded for completeness — a countersignature never gates execution.
fields.label: Countersigner Name

fields.description: Title printed under the Service Provider signature (e.g. "Managing Member").
fields.label: Countersigner Title

fields.description: Shown next to the signature checkbox and recorded verbatim (with a hash) on every signature as proof of intent to sign. Edit here when legal wording changes; already-executed signatures keep the text that was shown at the time.
fields.label: Signature Consent Text

fields.description: The E-SIGN Act consumer disclosure shown before signing and recorded verbatim on every signature: the right to receive a paper copy, how to withdraw consent, and the hardware/software needed to read and keep the agreement. Required for an electronic signature to be enforceable against a consumer.
fields.label: Electronic Records Disclosure

fields.description: Extra addresses alerted when a contract is signed or declined, alongside the contract owner. Leave empty to notify the owner only.
fields.label: Signature Notification Emails

fields.description: Master switch for the attribution pipeline (crm_enhancements/attribution.py): first-touch propagation of UTM values across Lead → Opportunity → Customer, the website ingress endpoint, and the Lead Source gate. Off by default. Turning it off stops enforcement immediately and leaves every value already captured intact.
fields.label: Enable Lead Attribution

fields.description: Block the save of a NEW Lead with no Lead Source. Existing Leads are never blocked — enforcing on every save would stop anyone editing the ~225 historical records until they were backfilled by hand. A source we can derive from captured UTM values is stamped automatically rather than throwing.
fields.label: Require Lead Source on New Leads

fields.description: Same rule for Opportunity. This is the one that matters for spend evaluation: as of 2026-08-04, 809 of 815 Opportunities carried no source at all. Switch OFF first if the sales team is blocked mid-day — that is what this toggle exists for.
fields.label: Require Lead Source on New Opportunities

fields.description: Accept POSTs from the WordPress marketing site at crm_enhancements.web_lead.submit_web_lead. While off the endpoint returns a generic refusal without touching the database. Requires the shared secret below — an unset secret authorises nobody.
fields.label: Enable Website Lead Ingress

fields.description: Lead Owner assigned to website submissions. Deliberately not guessed: routing real enquiries to the wrong person is worse than leaving them unassigned, where the Attribution Gaps report surfaces them.
fields.label: Website Lead Owner

fields.description: Bearer token the WordPress side must send in the Authorization header. Compared in constant time and fails closed when unset. Rotate by changing it here and on the WordPress side together — there is no grace window.
fields.label: Website Ingress Shared Secret

fields.description: Block a NEW Customer whose customer_type is Commercial / Company / Partnership from being saved with no industry. Residential and Individual accounts are never asked — a homeowner has no industry. Enforced by crm_enhancements/data_quality.enforce_industry rather than by reqd, because reqd is evaluated on every save by every caller and would park every QuickBooks-synced customer in manual review (QBO inserts without ignore_mandatory).
fields.label: Require Industry on New Commercial Accounts

fields.description: Extend the rule to existing commercial accounts. Leave OFF until the backlog is cleared: 732 commercial customers have no industry today, and turning this on before backfilling them means editing a phone number on any of them fails with an error about a field the user never touched. Clear them with the Account Data Quality report, then switch this on to close the loop.
fields.label: ...and on Edits to Existing Accounts

fields.description: Show the Speed-to-Lead queue (open Leads with no outbound Communication yet, oldest first, with hours waiting) on the Sales Dashboard. Each widget appears only where the block is placed and only for the department's roles.
fields.label: Enable Speed-to-Lead Queue Widget

fields.description: Show open Opportunities untouched for 14+ days on the Sales Dashboard, grouped by owner. Same 14-day threshold as the Stalled Opportunities KPI.
fields.label: Enable Stalled Deals Widget

fields.description: Show Closed-Won Opportunities that still have no Project on the Sales Dashboard, oldest first — the same gap the Hand-Off Backlog KPI counts.
fields.label: Enable Hand-Off Backlog Widget

fields.description: Show Active maintenance contracts ending within 90 days on the Sales Dashboard, soonest first, flagging those already marked non-renewing.
fields.label: Enable Renewal Radar Widget

fields.description: Show today's maintenance visits (scheduled, in progress and completed) on the Operations Dashboard, with the assigned technician and completion percent.
fields.label: Enable Today's Visits Widget

fields.description: Show managed-device compliance and stale check-ins on the Operations Dashboard. Reads the Managed Device records the MDM sync writes; renders nothing if device management is unused.
fields.label: Enable Fleet & Device Health Widget

fields.description: Show recent maintenance visits flagged with out-of-range chemistry readings on the Operations Dashboard, newest first, with the site and technician.
fields.label: Enable Chemistry Alerts Widget

fields.description: Show recently completed visits with no labour captured against them on the Operations Dashboard — the leak behind under-billed maintenance work.
fields.label: Enable Labor Capture Gaps Widget

fields.description: Show in-flight Water Feature Designs on the Design Dashboard grouped by status, with each design's age and completion percent.
fields.label: Enable Design WIP Board Widget

fields.description: Show designs that have reached Reviewed but are not yet Issued on the Design Dashboard, oldest first — the queue waiting on a human decision.
fields.label: Enable Sign-Off Queue Widget

fields.description: Show designs carrying blockers or warnings on the Design Dashboard, so an incomplete design is caught before it reaches Production rather than after.
fields.label: Enable Hand-Off Readiness Widget

fields.description: Show issued designs whose selected pump sits closest to its computed head requirement on the Design Dashboard — the thin-margin selections most likely to underperform in the field.
fields.label: Enable Hydraulic Headroom Widget

fields.description: Show active Build projects on the Production Dashboard, oldest first, with days open, percent complete and whether the expected end date has passed.
fields.label: Enable Build WIP & Aging Widget

fields.description: Show overdue project process steps on the Production Dashboard, with days overdue and the responsible role.
fields.label: Enable Milestone Slippage Widget

fields.description: Show material requests for active projects that are not fully received on the Production Dashboard, flagging any whose required-by date has passed.
fields.label: Enable Material Readiness Widget

fields.description: Show active projects with an hours budget on the Production Dashboard, ranked by how far actual elapsed time has run past that budget.
fields.label: Enable Hours Budget vs Actual Widget

fields.description: Show the sessions to leads to opportunities to won cascade on the Marketing Dashboard, with the conversion rate at each step over the last 30 and 90 days.
fields.label: Enable Funnel Cascade Widget

fields.description: Show month-to-date Marketing Spend by channel with the resulting cost per lead on the Marketing Dashboard. Channels with spend but no attributed leads are shown rather than hidden.
fields.label: Enable Channel Spend & CPL Widget

fields.description: Show recent Leads with no lead source (or the pre-Aug-2026 Unknown bucket) on the Marketing Dashboard — the attribution gap, listed as rows someone can actually go and fix.
fields.label: Enable Unsourced Leads Widget

fields.description: Show whether the nightly GA4 and Search Console pulls are succeeding on the Marketing Dashboard, with the last pull's error text. Search Console failed 40 consecutive nightly pulls with no visible signal before this widget existed.
fields.label: Enable Source Health Widget

fields.description: Show overdue and due-soon training assignments by learner on the HR Dashboard.
fields.label: Enable Training Compliance Widget

fields.description: Show which active employees have logged time in the last 7 days and which have not on the HR Dashboard. Stays quiet until the time doctypes carry real data.
fields.label: Enable Time Capture Widget

fields.description: Show recent hires and separations with tenure on the HR Dashboard, alongside current active headcount.
fields.label: Enable Headcount Movement Widget

fields.description: Show upcoming work anniversaries and joining-date milestones for active employees on the HR Dashboard. Reads Employee dates only — no birthdays, which the Employee master does not reliably carry.
fields.label: Enable People Calendar Widget

fields.description: Show one status tile per department on the Executive Dashboard — Good/Watch/Bad counts from each department's latest KPI Snapshot, with a link through to that dashboard. Reads snapshots only; it never aggregates live.
fields.label: Enable Company Scorecard Widget

fields.description: Show cash collected, receivables and days sales outstanding from the latest Finance snapshot on the Executive Dashboard.
fields.label: Enable Cash & Runway Widget

fields.description: Show closed-won value, open pipeline and booked-but-unbuilt backlog on the Executive Dashboard, from the latest Sales and Production snapshots.
fields.label: Enable Bookings & Backlog Widget

fields.description: Show what is stuck company-wide on the Executive Dashboard: stale KPI snapshots, failing integrations, and the oldest un-handed-off won deals.
fields.label: Enable Risk Queue Widget
